decisions.reason: As a flagship cheese close to the firm's core business, a product that has lasted this long would likely have revealed sufficient value to justify continued shelf space at low ongoing cost.

The spicy cheese line still fits the core assortment and supports variety, but after several years the learning value of keeping all such variants open is lower and pruning risk is higher than at launch.
A mild creamy soft cheese is a mainstream extension in a familiar segment, so if it remains on the market by 2022 management would usually keep it unless performance is clearly weak.

Because washed-rind soft cheese serves a narrower taste niche and the product has had several years to prove itself, the option value of waiting further is now likely below the value of reallocating resources.
